metadata.build: Release /O2 /Ob2 /DNDEBUG; OPTION_USE_ASSERTS=ON; dedicated; routing TUs without /GL
notes: All values are medians of three fresh processes.
CPU counters cover entire main/worker measurement windows; Windows CPU accounting has coarse granularity.
25 ms settling sleeps occur outside reported build/tick wall windows.
ahead includes deliberate out-of-tick waits in wall_ns; main_cpu_ns conservatively includes controller CPU.
Graph preparation is separate from normal tick measurements; process CPU/peak memory include setup and old generation.
All 150 trials compare Work, published/retained frontier digest, every final Row field and DB digest where applicable.
